film: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
query: Brad Pitt as Benjamin Button, born old in New Orleans in 1918 and ageing backwards, and Cate Blanchett as Daisy, the love of his life; David Fincher.

Brad Pitt as Billy Beane, the Oakland Athletics general manager who builds a winning baseball team on a tiny budget using statistics, with Jonah Hill's economist Peter Brand.

Bradley Cooper as Pat, a man with bipolar disorder out of a psychiatric hospital, and Jennifer Lawrence as the widow Tiffany, who make a deal to enter a dance competition; Robert De Niro as his father.
Tom Hanks as Richard Phillips, captain of the cargo ship Maersk Alabama, hijacked by Somali pirates led by Muse (Barkhad Abdi): 'I'm the captain now'.

Michael Keaton as Riggan Thomson, a has-been actor famous for playing a superhero, staging a Broadway play, made to look like one continuous shot; Edward Norton co-stars.

Domhnall Gleeson as Caleb, a programmer invited by his CEO (Oscar Isaac) to a remote house to test whether the humanoid robot Ava (Alicia Vikander) is truly conscious.

Jake Gyllenhaal as Lou Bloom, a creepy loner who films car crashes and crime scenes at night in LA and sells the footage to a TV news director (Rene Russo).
Christian Bale, Steve Carell, Ryan Gosling and Brad Pitt as investors who bet against the US housing market before the 2008 crash; Margot Robbie explains it from a bathtub.
Ryan Reynolds as Wade Wilson, a mercenary with cancer who becomes the scarred, wisecracking Deadpool after an experiment by Ajax, breaking the fourth wall. The first one, not Deadpool & Wolverine.

Ryan Gosling as K, a replicant blade runner who finds the bones of a replicant who gave birth and searches for Rick Deckard (Harrison Ford); Denis Villeneuve. The sequel, not the 1982 original.

Bradley Cooper as Jackson Maine, an alcoholic country rock star who discovers Lady Gaga's Ally singing in a drag bar; the song 'Shallow'. The 2018 version.

Anthony Hopkins as Anthony, an elderly man with dementia who can't tell what's real as his daughter (Olivia Colman) and his flat keep changing; Florian Zeller.

film: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish

Antoine Fuqua's biopic with Jaafar Jackson playing his uncle Michael Jackson, from the Jackson 5 to superstardom; Colman Domingo as his father Joe Jackson.
